mapper.sql: c.id, c.title, c.record_type, c.status, c.source_type, c.source_label, c.tags, c.favorite_flag, LEFT(r.content, 220) AS excerpt, c.current_revision_id, r.revision_no, c.version, c.captured_at, c.create_time, c.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS active_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ARCHIVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS archived_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'TRASHED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS trashed_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS today_created_count FROM ai_capsule WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_subject_type = 'ADMIN_USER' AND del_flag = '0'
